description: This file defines the 'vtigerRSS' class for managing RSS feeds within the vtiger CRM system, including fetching, displaying, saving, and deleting RSS feed data.

classes.name: vtigerRSS
classes.description: Class for handling RSS feed operations such as fetching, displaying, saving, and deleting RSS feeds in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: setRSSUrl
methods.description: Fetches RSS data from a URL and initializes class variables with feed info.

methods.name: getListViewRSSHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying a list of RSS feed items.

methods.name: getListViewHomeRSSHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for RSS feeds to display on the home page with a maximum number of entries.

methods.name: saveRSSUrl
methods.description: Saves a new RSS feed URL into the database with optional starred status.

methods.name: getCRMRssFeeds
methods.description: Retrieves and displays user-specific RSS feeds with starred status.

methods.name: getAllRssFeeds
methods.description: Retrieves and displays all non-CRM RSS feeds.

methods.name: getRssUrlfromId
methods.description: Returns the RSS URL for a given RSS feed ID.

methods.name: getRSSHeadings
methods.description: Returns HTML with RSS feed heading information for a given RSS ID.

methods.name: getTopStarredRSSFeeds
methods.description: Returns HTML listing starred RSS feeds with an option to add new feeds.

methods.name: getStarredRssHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for displaying starred RSS feeds with their latest items.

methods.name: getSelectedRssHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for a specific RSS feed identified by ID.

methods.name: getRSSCategoryHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for RSS feeds categorized view.

methods.name: getRssFeedsbyCategory
methods.description: Returns HTML listing RSS feeds by category.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Deletes an RSS feed entry from the database.
